author: Quinn's Ideas
description:
For this year’s Halloween special, we’re exploring H. P. Lovecraft’s The Nameless City, Nick Cutter’s The Deep, and Thomas Ligotti’s The Red Tower. From buried ruins to an underwater research station and a factory producing impossible things, these stories ask what we’re really uncovering—and why we keep going.

Organism has returned with a friend for the occasion. We were planning a quiet movie night.

Happy Halloween.

Full spoilers for all three stories.
